scope: Pinned open search PR heads reviewed independently at their exact base..head deltas.

validation.command: uv run pytest perception/test_search_events.py perception/test_search_localization.py planner/test_search.py relay/tests/test_intent_v1.py relay/tests/test_search_runtime.py relay/tests/test_search_deployment.py relay/tests/test_search_detection.py adapters/sim/test_search_demo.py relay/tests/test_search_demo_roundtrip.py -q

prs.head: 096dda9c600bb273a9a4fb6a183e19528e00f25c
prs.callchain: LiveDetectionWorker emits ProcessedFrameEvent and SightingEvent; SearchRuntime.observe_processed_frame and observe_sighting call CoverageLedger; SearchPlanner creates its tasks.
prs.evidence: Freshness, mission, source, epoch, pose and duplicate-worker checks are covered by perception/test_search_events.py.

prs.head: c43a220d0d6ea7d8c3a2aba6bc70179efa49c334
prs.callchain: SearchRuntime.prepare builds SearchRequest and calls SearchPlanner.plan; SearchPreview feeds the runtime ledger and coverage route.
prs.evidence: Planner tests cover balanced contiguous assignment, unreachable routes, disconnected occupancy and calibrated floor height.

prs.head: c47cd74c100ee6a94fb5549d4b29d9193c350525
prs.callchain: AutonomySession.preview_search calls prepare; prepared mission is later bound to the confirming websocket intent.
prs.evidence: Tests pin map and transit plan and reject changed map pins and duplicate IDs.

prs.head: 05ac8558d825ac3f192ae336c262ef3749646718
prs.callchain: Dispatcher completion observer activates a task; workers then deliver coverage; execute marks unfinished tasks incomplete.
prs.evidence: Original synchronous route test passed. Async observer retention was missing in the composed caller and is fixed by 15a0cb1.

prs.head: 8181d77cc0b0704e061886820a96775a72b05bea
prs.callchain: SearchRuntime.detection_worker supplies accepted frame pose and camera model to FiveFrameLocalizer then stores SearchLocalization.
prs.evidence: Tests reject bad camera geometry, duplicate and stale frames, unapproved zones, and concave-zone invalid medians.

prs.head: 5b6f983e5f5dfe52420ebefb4833d73ba07cb7f0
prs.callchain: Detector candidate and localizer state are serialized by status_payload and exposed by search status and acknowledgement endpoints.
prs.evidence: Concurrent callback/status test passes; endpoint session ownership was added in 15a0cb1.

prs.head: 102ff306c25b0cebf0a9f9a92d7b452cd37138de
prs.callchain: validate_intent gates HTTP and websocket inputs before AutonomySession.submit and SearchRuntime.prepare.
prs.evidence: Intent tests cover profile enablement, confirmation, selected aircraft, and exact zone/target arguments.

prs.head: 5667a8ce861aeece1011e030a8a6872c8ef8e3dd
prs.callchain: SEARCH Plan reaches AdapterDispatcher navigation checks, then completion callback updates task state before processed frames are admitted.
prs.evidence: Real worker-frame route test and full pending fake-node test pass.

prs.head: 0ba2645db4231547af1830a055097a7459c148b2
prs.callchain: Accepted processed frame caches pose and camera; following sighting enters a per-ID localizer and status includes frame provenance.
prs.evidence: Route test verifies five-frame localization and status fields.

prs.head: f43b595ea0f044194dedef46ce183a9300af450a
prs.callchain: AutonomyConfig.from_env loads navigation first, then strict search configuration with matching artifact pin and owner-approved zones.
prs.evidence: Loader tests reject absent navigation, malformed fields, duplicate JSON keys, ambiguous area/source inputs.

prs.head: 4c430f0221a8c31e8594ad29e77d866d533593e9
prs.callchain: HTTP preview writes frozen mission; websocket submission checks full fingerprint and TTL; stop/select/membership revoke unstarted missions.
prs.evidence: Lease test covers changed retry/selection and expiry. 15a0cb1 adds endpoint-session binding.

prs.head: 39c1f9f289c99a99099e43d0d9d1d069977c9ab2
prs.callchain: App lifespan starts composition, AutonomySession starts required workers before route dispatch, worker callbacks enter SearchRuntime, status reports workers.
prs.evidence: Configured worker and startup-failure tests pass. Pending-worker lifetime defect fixed in 15a0cb1.

prs.head: db24faae5b3a808ba704abb3d92c8699ab0ccee4
prs.callchain: Test factories supply deterministic frames, measured pose, and calibrated camera model to the production SearchDetectionFactory.
prs.evidence: Synthetic config test and fake-node round trip pass.

prs.head: 1665b83c8d7fc63e703c3c2d01948574546f2c78
prs.callchain: HTTP preview to websocket confirmation to fake-node acknowledgement drives relay resume and status polling.
prs.evidence: Regression now delays real GOTO terminal acks and observes detector running while route is pending.

prs.head: 6acf9795422f43ca1a6508272671d9ba5225270e
prs.callchain: Worker callbacks, status reads and acknowledgement share SearchRuntime state under RLock; capacity removes terminal work only.
prs.evidence: Threaded callback/status test and bounded mission/candidate tests pass.

prs.head: 21161907d455141edb3ec556c5801c3391c6f8b1
prs.callchain: Configured profile feeds both autonomy intent validation and transcript compiler; enabled SEARCH is present only when navigation and search runtime deploy together.
prs.evidence: Language/navigation wiring test includes search-enabled profile. Search demo assertion remains green; console-only changed functions were assigned to the console slice.
